! Title: shiiren-supplemental
! Expires: 4 hours
! Homepage: https://github.com/crayka/shiiren-adblock-lists

! Hand-picked, individually verified supplementary rules for gaps confirmed
! by real testing, not present in the mirrored public lists. Every entry
! here targets a tracking/measurement endpoint only, never a page's actual
! functional resource, kept intentionally small to avoid false positives.

! Google Ads viewability-measurement script (reports ad impressions were
! seen; not the ad creative itself).
||tpc.googlesyndication.com/sodar/

! DoubleClick cross-device ad-attribution id sync.
||googleads.g.doubleclick.net/pagead/id

! YouTube's own first-party ad-impression/interaction stats pings.
||youtube.com/api/stats/ads
||youtube.com/ptracking

! Sites running anti-adblock-detection plugins (e.g. "CHP Adblock") probe
! whether this exact script loaded and set window.adsbygoogle before showing
! a "please disable your ad blocker" wall. Outright blocking it is what
! trips that check; redirecting it to a harmless local stub (same technique
! uBlock Origin uses, resource mirrored from their resources.json) satisfies
! the probe without letting any real ad content through.
||pagead2.googlesyndication.com/pagead/js/adsbygoogle.js$redirect=googlesyndication_adsbygoogle.js
